candidates.title: Microspine robotics for extreme-surface anchoring
candidates.shift: Robots gaining the ability to physically latch onto irregular natural surfaces (icebergs) using microspine claws, beyond flat man-made surfaces.
candidates.ai_read: Tentative, off-map: could eventually let sensors/robots perch on damaged facades, cliffs or rubble for structural monitoring; strange leap from lab grippers to arctic ice.
candidates.evidence: IEEE Spectrum report on Canadian roboticists using microspines to land drones on icebergs.
candidates.initial_analysis: From robots requiring flat engineered surfaces to robots gripping irregular natural terrain; if generalized, could enable autonomous inspection/repair robots on damaged or non-standard building surfaces.
candidates.author: Tim Hornyak

candidates.title: Agentic AI drones for post-disaster structural triage
candidates.shift: Shift from manual post-disaster inspection to autonomous agentic AI plus aerial robotics assessing structural damage after typhoons.
candidates.ai_read: Tentative: could speed insurance claims and reshape construction-inspection labor and disaster-response contracts; strange that an AI agent now renders a building-safety judgment autonomously.
candidates.evidence: Study describing an agentic AI + UAV model for autonomous post-typhoon structural damage assessment.
candidates.initial_analysis: From human-led post-disaster inspection to autonomous agentic assessment; driver is climate-driven typhoon frequency; if common, insurers/regulators may require agentic-AI-certified inspections before rebuild permits.
candidates.author: Liupengfei Wu, Linna Geng, Jin Xue et al.

candidates.title: Circular-economy governance models for shrinking regions
candidates.shift: Shrinking cities pivoting to circular-economy and regional-collaboration governance as an intentional path rather than managed decline.
candidates.ai_read: Tentative: foreshadows 'de-growth real estate' governance frameworks that mass retailers in shrinking secondary markets may need to plan around (store rationalization, land repurposing).
candidates.evidence: Case study of Parkstad Limburg using evolutionary governance theory to enable circular-economy path-creation amid population decline.
candidates.initial_analysis: From managed urban decline to proactive circular-economy path-creation; driver is demographic shrinkage in secondary EU regions; could push retail real estate strategy toward repurposing over closure.
candidates.author: Marjan Marjanović, Raoul Beunen

candidates.title: Volunteer-led adaptive reuse becomes formal displacement-housing model
candidates.shift: A volunteer initiative restoring abandoned buildings into stable homes for internally displaced people is elevated to a national pavilion, signaling institutional legitimization of grassroots adaptive reuse.
candidates.ai_read: Tentative: could preview vacant retail/commercial buildings being repurposed for displaced or migrant populations, blurring retail real estate and emergency housing stock.
candidates.evidence: ArchDaily on CO-HATY-designed Ukrainian Pavilion at 2027 Venice Biennale, focused on restoring abandoned buildings for displaced people.
candidates.initial_analysis: From ad hoc volunteer building reuse to institutionally showcased displacement-housing model; driver is war-driven displacement; if formalized elsewhere, vacant commercial buildings could become codified emergency housing stock.
candidates.author: Antonia Piñeiro

candidates.title: Weather as a quantified driver of store-trip demand
candidates.shift: Research quantifying how weather variables shape day-to-day travel/activity demand at hourly resolution, beyond simple storm closures.
candidates.ai_read: Tentative: could feed dynamic staffing/parking/inventory models tied to hyperlocal forecasts; retailers currently use weather mostly for seasonal buying, not hourly ops.
candidates.evidence: Transportation Research Record study combining travel-demand data with hourly/daily/monthly weather from the CMAP household survey.
candidates.initial_analysis: From static seasonal weather planning to granular hour-by-hour weather-linked demand modeling; if adopted, store staffing/parking/inventory systems could flex dynamically with forecasts rather than fixed schedules.
candidates.author: Nazmul Arefin Khan, Joshua Auld

candidates.title: Demountable timber public buildings as circular-construction default
candidates.shift: A major public library is designed fully demountable/circular in timber, positioned as a civic 'living room' rather than a permanent fixture.
candidates.ai_read: Tentative: reframes demountability from niche pavilion trick to mainstream civic/commercial standard; retail/mixed-use developers may need design-for-disassembly requirements.
candidates.evidence: Dezeen coverage of OBA Next Lab, a 1,175 sqm demountable timber structure in Amsterdam.
candidates.initial_analysis: From permanent fixed construction to fully demountable circular buildings as civic norm; if it scales, retail construction codes and leases may need to accommodate modular, relocatable store formats.
candidates.author: Jon Astbury
